profileSummary.text: Fullstack developer with over a year of experience on production meeting-notes and IoT products. Works on features end to end: APIs, web and mobile screens, testing, release, and production fixes.

projects.narrative: A meeting assistant that turns long recordings into summaries, decisions, and action items you can search later. Worked on the capture side, from upload to a finished summary.
Open-source AI workspace for non-developers: an orchestrator delegates work to specialist AI roles, and results are accepted only when checks prove them.

employmentBullets: Built resumable multipart uploads for recordings over 100 MB: after a dropped connection the upload continues from the last finished part, with retries that respect the server's backoff.
Added local backup of in-progress recordings on web and mobile, so a crash or closed tab no longer loses a meeting.
Built backend support for Sensio IoT room controls: commands, device-state feedback, and permissions, keeping the requested action separate from the device's reported state.
Turned design mockups into web and mobile screens, and handled production issues and releases with the infrastructure and security engineers.
employmentSummary: Backend and fullstack developer on Sensio Notes, a meeting assistant, and Sensio IoT, smart-room controls.

4: Completed a backend engineering program covering API design, authentication, databases, testing, and AI integration.
